articles.headline: Deadly Stampede at Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal
articles.brief: A tragic stampede at a crowded Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata claimed the lives of at least 17 people, with dozens injured. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other national leaders expressed deep grief, announcing financial assistance for the victims' families while rescue and relief operations continued at Calcutta Medical College.

articles.headline: ICICI Bank Beats Estimates with Strong Q2 Profit
articles.brief: India's ICICI Bank reported a robust 20.1% rise in Q2 net profit, outperforming market expectations and demonstrating resilience in the country's banking and financial sector amid shifting macroeconomic conditions.

articles.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 Profit Rises as Deputy MD Steps Down
articles.brief: HDFC Bank posted a 4.7% increase in second-quarter profit, alongside the announcement that Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down from his role at the end of December.

articles.headline: Egypt's Sisi Seeks Mandate to Help Defend Saudi Arabia
articles.brief: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi has asked parliament for backing to deploy military support in defense of Saudi Arabia if formally requested, highlighting regional security cooperation in the Middle East.

articles.headline: Bank of Canada Flags Higher Inflation Amid Oil Surge
articles.brief: Bank of Canada Governor Macklem stated that the central bank foresees a sharply higher inflation outlook driven by surging global oil prices and ongoing commodity market volatility.

articles.headline: Reliance and Blinkit Executives Named in Expired Food Probe
articles.brief: An Indian state food safety authority has named senior executives from Reliance Consumer and quick-commerce platform Blinkit in an ongoing investigation regarding expired food products and regulatory non-compliance.

articles.headline: Missiles Strike Aden Airport Amid Regional Interceptions
articles.brief: Missiles struck Aden airport while the Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted an incoming projectile headed toward Yanbu, heightening security concerns across critical regional infrastructure nodes.

articles.headline: FSSAI Issues Regulatory Notices to Nestlé and HUL
articles.brief: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has issued formal notices to Hindustan Unilever and Nestlé India over alleged product misleading claims and safety non-compliance issues.

articles.headline: France Protests Lead to Hundreds of Arrests
articles.brief: Violent clashes broke out across Paris and other French cities during nationwide demonstrations over rising living costs, resulting in torched vehicles, looted shops, and at least 272 arrests by police.

articles.headline: IPL 2027 Auction Scheduled for December 16 in Goa
articles.brief: The Board of Control for Cricket in India has officially locked December 16 for the IPL 2027 player auction to be held in Goa, with team briefings slated for the preceding day.

articles.headline: South Africa Recalls Kagiso Rabada for Australia Test
articles.brief: South Africa has brought star fast bowler Kagiso Rabada back into the squad to bring extra heat against Australia after missing the opening Test due to a hamstring injury recovery.

articles.headline: Indianapolis Removes Century-Old Dam to Restore River
articles.brief: Crews in Indianapolis have begun dismantling the 127-year-old Emrichsville Dam to restore the White River's natural flow, improve aquatic wildlife habitats, and enhance recreational safety.

articles.headline: Jack Dorsey's San Francisco Mansion Renovation Drags On
articles.brief: Jack Dorsey's extensive $32 million mansion renovation in San Francisco has continued past its fourteenth year, drawing ongoing complaints from frustrated neighboring residents over noise and disruptions.

articles.headline: Blind UK Man Overcomes Rejection to Build Business
articles.brief: After facing rejection from over 1,000 jobs, a 23-year-old blind entrepreneur in the UK launched a successful accessibility-focused business and won the prestigious King's Trust Young Achiever Award.
